notes: Seed design data only. IDs are referenced by stage layout legend values and reward tables.
Traps intentionally have no direct rewards; reward-bearing map objects are modeled as gimmicks.

enemies.lesson: Basic attack timing, patrol spacing, and contact damage.
React to warning, jump or dash away from burst movement.
enemies.telegraph: Flash or warning marker before charge.

enemies.lesson: Maintain platforming control while dodging projectiles.
Low-threat pressure and boss summon management.
enemies.reward_interaction: Grants small defeat drops when used outside boss summon caps.
enemies.telegraph: Spawn puff or drop marker before becoming active.

bosses.reward_interaction: Boss defeat grants drop_boss_slime_king; boss-stage clear reward is defined separately in economy_tables.stage_clear_rewards.

patterns.counterplay: Move out of shadow and jump over shockwave.
Move to safe floor segments or platforms.
Jump, dash away, or stand on platform.
Clear summons or reposition before next pattern.

traps.lesson: Basic jump spacing and hazard respect.
traps.warning: Visible spikes. No delayed telegraph required.
traps.reward_interaction: No direct reward; may guard optional pickups.
traps.reset_behavior: Knock player back or respawn at checkpoint depending on implementation.

traps.reward_interaction: No direct reward; may create route pressure.

traps.lesson: Commit to jumps and recover from missed platforms.
traps.reward_interaction: No direct reward; may separate safe and risky routes.

traps.warning: Shadow or warning line before falling.
traps.reward_interaction: No direct reward; future optional challenge pressure.

gimmicks.purpose: Support drop-through routing and vertical map movement.
gimmicks.reward_interaction: May provide access to optional rewards but grants none directly.
gimmicks.risk: Drop-through must not strand player below required route.

gimmicks.reward_interaction: May provide access to optional rewards but grants none directly.
gimmicks.risk: Must have safe start/end positions and predictable cycle.

gimmicks.purpose: Teach direct pickup collection without requiring a chest or enemy defeat.
gimmicks.reward_interaction: Directly grants a small coin pickup.

gimmicks.purpose: Unlock a nearby locked gate in a simple route lesson.
gimmicks.reward_interaction: No direct currency reward; unlocks route access.
gimmicks.risk: Required keys must be reachable with base movement.

gimmicks.purpose: Gate optional reward or simple route objective.
gimmicks.reward_interaction: May guard an optional reward or critical path, but grants none directly.
gimmicks.risk: Required keys must be reachable without soft lock.

gimmicks.reward_interaction: May reveal a coin cluster, material node, or chest.
gimmicks.risk: Should be readable enough for first-slice testing.

gimmicks.reward_interaction: Grants chest reward drops when opened.

gimmicks.purpose: Teach resource gathering without complex crafting UI.
gimmicks.reward_interaction: Grants material node drops when collected, broken, or interacted with.
Triggers the stage clear reward table and card choice.
No direct reward; preserves readable boss combat.
